title: Slurm node grid - scenarios
description: Hand-written clusters that render the same way every time. Every panel carries its own CSV, so this dashboard needs no exporter, no Prometheus and no scrape to have happened.

panels.title: Every state, and the colour it gets
panels.description: One node per state string Slurm can report, grouped by the raw state so the group header is the input and the cell is the output. The four states at the end match no rule and are drawn hollow rather than coloured — that is the panel refusing to paint an unknown state with the threshold base colour.
